# Protein-preparation fixtures

`7kpa.pdb` is the RCSB PDB coordinate entry 7KPA. `D84.cif` is the matching RCSB Chemical
Component Dictionary definition for ligand D84. They are retained verbatim so the hydrated
reference-contact regression is reproducible without a network request.

- `7kpa.pdb` SHA-256: `da4fa18e7c52750ec6b9de35fd363357452b99e3f2b3064f831def46f31175d6`
- `D84.cif` SHA-256: `c6e43b72a44b36ae8a068b8e4b1b5644490c094c31f64b57003fc990f4634871`

Source: [RCSB Protein Data Bank](https://www.rcsb.org/structure/7KPA) and the RCSB Chemical
Component Dictionary entry D84. These files are test evidence, not Molarium-authored code.
